description: From a logo (a PNG or SVG the person gave, or a picture in one of their designs): its palette (primary, secondary, accent, paper, ink — always readable), a type pairing from Paletoo’s library with Cyrillic, the colour and text styles, a one-page brand sheet and a first post. Counts as one design. The logo may come as `file` (ChatGPT) or `image_url`.

file.description: ChatGPT fills it: the picture the person attached in this chat { download_url, file_id, mime_type, file_name }; fetched once, kept with this design only

from_design.description: or: a design that holds the logo as a picture (its biggest PNG picture, or `layer`)

image_url.description: the person’s picture: an https link or a data: URL (PNG / JPEG / WebP ≤ ~180 KB); one you cannot pass: upload_picture — never describe or redraw it

layer.description: the picture layer’s id in from_design

logo.description: the logo as a data URL or base64 (PNG or SVG, up to ~130 KB)

mood.description: words about the brand («warm, crafty, family bakery»)

pairing.description: a pairing id (geometric, editorial, classic, sport, friendly, bookish, code, neutral); none: picked for the palette

picture_is.description: photo (fills the photo frame), product or person (cut out, in the cut-out place), logo (a corner + its colours as the brand’s); auto (default): read from the file

tagline.description: the brand’s line for the sheet and first post; e.g. «Bread since 1998»

name: brand_from_logo
title: Brand from a logo
